summary: End-to-end UI + integration testing of the NEW bi-directional AI Advisory canvas views on /ai. All 8 flows plus reset verified. 1) 'What services do you offer?' -> canvas-service-tiles renders 6 tiles; clicking canvas-service-tile-personal-tax posts a user message 'Tell me about your Personal Tax service.' and Fiona replies (message count 3->5). 2) 'How much do your services cost?' -> canvas-fee-slider renders; changing slider value 1->3 updates the band + fee display; canvas-fee-submit posts a message referencing turnover band and Fiona replies. 3) 'I keep spending hours on admin and chasing invoices' -> canvas-roi-slider renders; drag 6->12 hours updates time-back/year & value-reclaimed; canvas-roi-submit posts message and Fiona replies. 4) 'I want to combine bookkeeping and payroll' -> canvas-package-list renders 6 toggle items; toggling two updates canvas-package-total from £0/mo to £120/mo; canvas-package-submit posts message and Fiona replies. 5) 'I'm not sure it's worth switching accountants' -> canvas-comparison-flip renders; card flips (inner text changes); canvas-comparison-submit posts message and Fiona replies. 6) 'I feel overwhelmed and behind on everything' -> canvas-pain-points renders 8 tickable items; two selected; canvas-pain-submit posts message and Fiona replies. 7a) Regression: 'Hi, I'm Sarah Johnson from Marine Leisure Ltd' -> dynamic-intake-form appears auto-filled (business='Marine Leisure Ltd', contact='Sarah Johnson'). 7b) 'I'd like to book a consultation' -> scheduler-dates/times/book button render. 7c) 'Who would I work with?' -> canvas contains 'Oliver Grills'. 8) Animated transitions between views executed smoothly via AnimatePresence mode='wait' (no blank canvas / no runtime errors observed in console). 9) btn-reset-chat clears chat and returns canvas to Welcome view ('Meet Fiona, your J A Fell & Co advisor'). Backend LLM routing (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent key) selected the expected view for every prompt on the first try.
critical_code_review_comments: DynamicCanvas.jsx (632 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting each canvas view into its own file under components/ai/canvas/*.jsx for maintainability.

AIMode.saveState still closes over stale `messages`/`intake` values on the very first send (documented in prior iterations); low priority as the /advisor/state POST following the send call captures the merged state via the explicit args passed to saveState.
PainPoints selected labels are joined lowercase in the outgoing user message ('chasing invoices & late payments, ...') — reads fine but consider preserving original casing.

Comparison flip uses AnimatePresence mode='wait'; inner text is briefly empty between the exit/enter animations. Not user-visible but caused a false-negative substring check in automation (worked around by comparing text lengths).

canvas-package-total, canvas-package-submit and canvas-pain-submit share the 'canvas-package-*' / 'canvas-pain-*' prefix with the toggle items — automated selectors must filter these out (documented for next testing agent).
test_credentials: Not required — all bi-directional canvas flows tested as an anonymous visitor. Persistence via /api/advisor/state only fires for signed-in users and is covered by existing pytest suite (iteration_3).
seed_data_creation: None. No intake/meeting/contact submissions performed in this run (scheduler render verified without booking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI canvas testids: canvas-service-tiles + canvas-service-tile-<serviceId>; canvas-fee-slider + canvas-fee-submit; canvas-roi-slider + canvas-roi-submit; canvas-package-list + canvas-package-<id> + canvas-package-total + canvas-package-submit; canvas-comparison-flip + canvas-comparison-submit; canvas-pain-points + canvas-pain-<id> + canvas-pain-submit. When querying by testid prefix, filter out list/total/submit siblings. LLM latency ~5-8s per turn; poll chat-send-button 'disabled' attribute (null when idle) to gate the next action. Reset returns view to 'welcome' (no explicit testid on Welcome pane — assert on body text 'Meet Fiona' or 'AI Advisory Mode').
